mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 5.12% is above the long-term average, indicating a restrictive monetary policy that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of all cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 305 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or increase interest rates, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 305, the S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL are above their respective long-term averages (5.0% and 300), it indicates a restrictive monetary policy combined with persistent inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and CPIAUCSL > 300, the S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1450 thousand units indicate a strong housing market, a leading indicator of economic expansion and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1450, the S&P 500 produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (base year 2017=100) indicates robust economic activity and strong demand for goods, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 100, the S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production and housing starts are above their respective 3-month moving averages, it indicates a synchronized expansion in manufacturing and housing, driving economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 3-month MA and HOUST > 3-month MA, the S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL is above 300 and FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, it indicates a late-cycle economy with high inflation and restrictive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 300 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60d returns in more than 60% of cases.
